items.title: Kyler Murray: Targeting Week 12 return
items.text:
The Vikings are targeting Week 12 against the Falcons on Sunday, Nov. 29, for a return for Murray (hamstring), Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Woody Marks: Will once again serve as RB1
items.text:
Marks will be the Texans' lead back against the Browns on Sunday after David Montgomery (groin) was ruled out for that contest.

items.title: Ladd McConkey: Questionable for Monday Night Football
items.text:
McConkey (back) is listed as questionable for Monday night's game against the Ravens, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

items.title: Travis Etienne: Activated from injured reserve
items.text:
The Saints activated Etienne (hamstring) from injured reserve Saturday, but he remains questionable for Sunday's game against the Panthers, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reports.
